reviews.text: Good practice nice staff very helpful
Lovely very caring staff, very reasonable pricing. Take great care of my puppy. Highly recommend!
Would like to thank The Lodge vets for the lovely sympathy cards we received after we had to have our beautiful girl sent over the rainbow bridge,and for their kindness to her.
Local so good prices could be much lower no blue light discount either flea treatment high

I came across a small badger today on the grass by the farm on coleshill road B46, unable to move and clearly in pain & distressed, I spoke to a vet stood out side the lodge vets in Coleshill & this vet couldn't give a damn, was rude, arrogant and walked off as I was explaining where the poor little thing was, this is a vet ??? No a vet that clearly saw there was no money in it for him with 0 compassion to help.  I would never take my dog there or ever recommend.  This was a defensless
Wild animal that needed help, luckily after trying hours to get someone to help I came across luckys wildlife rescue on chelmsley wood, Keiran there thankfully had the badger collected immediately to be taken to be looked after & cared for, it's a non profitable charity. So there is kindness in the world but not from the lodge vets in Coleshill, you should be ashamed of yourself , 0 stars had to put one to get a review ?
Really nice staff and nice and quiet waiting room.
Such a lovely veterinary practice, all staff are so friendly and caring.The vets are all amazing and always take the time to explain and answer any questions  you may have regards your pet.

Always found this practice efficient and helpful for advice on the health care of our two cats.
Had to attend again recently with minor concerns about one of our cats. We got a rapid appointment, apparently they have extended their opening hours. Got a thorough and expert assessment and reassurance. Very pleased
A lovely vet practice, no issues booking an emergency appt. The staff were very caring and efficient. Of course, vet fees are expensive. Luckily, we have insurance .
